english.note: Use 解釋 as the all-purpose spoken verb for giving a reason or explaining why something happened.
This is the all-purpose verb for making something clear or giving its reason.
It is the all-purpose spoken choice for explaining a word’s meaning or asking someone to make an expression clearer.
This is the all-purpose choice when explaining what words, signs, dreams, or actions mean.
This is the all-purpose choice when someone gives reasons for an action, including explaining their own decision without necessarily arguing aggressively.
